payload.posture: Read Luke 22:14–20 as one movement in the Last Supper, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states at the hour Jesus reclines with the apostles, speaks of earnest desire and suffering, takes a cup before bread, gives bread in remembrance, and names a cup after supper as the new covenant in his blood. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Last Supper.
